_comment: Map catalog of finished maps on Google Drive – which there are and where. The top key is the country, under it `regions` and `subregions`; `mountains` is no country but the category of ranges (`ranges`); `id` names a node uniquely across the catalog (its osm.fr path); keys starting with `_` are catalog metadata, not countries. Written at the end of a build by workers/deploy/publish-map.py; never edited by hand.
